## Device and requested operation

- Manufacturer and exact model:
- EEP/profile and documentation version, if known:
- enocean-mqtt version and interface:
- Requested behavior (RX, TX, Teach-In, feedback):
- Already tested behavior and results:

## Technical evidence

Link to official technical manuals or specifications at the publisher's site.
Do not upload third-party documents unless you have permission to redistribute them.
Provide relevant telegram descriptions or sanitized samples where possible,
explaining the expected decoded values and whether these are live or replay tests.

Remove tokens, credentials, personal device names and installation-specific data.
If sender IDs must be shown, consistently pseudonymize them while preserving the
relationships needed to understand the example. Do not attach unfiltered captures.

Successful compilation, sent telegrams and confirmed device behavior are different
validation levels; identify which was actually observed.

Requests without sufficient technical information may not be implementable.
